WELCOME, OBSERVER

A city with a life of its own.

Watch 50 citizens work, trade, form relationships, elect leaders, and raise families. Click a person or choose one from Citizens to inspect their needs, memories, and changing motivations.

Drag to orbit. Scroll to zoom. Right-drag to pan. Time advances while the page is open; your world saves automatically in this browser. At 20×, generations evolve faster.

Environment lets you introduce weather, abundance, scarcity, or discoveries. You cannot command a citizen.

This is a procedural simulation with adaptive decision weights and generated thought summaries. Framework names are archetypes, not running ML libraries. Citizens are not conscious; thoughts are explanations of simulated state. No LLM service is connected.
